content:
The 25% price drop on AirPods Pro 3 down at one of the best prices to date is still live, but today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is starting off with these M5 MacBook Air configs at $270 off courtesy of the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store and these 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Cell models at $100 off. We also have the first discount on the new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro lock with Ultra Wideband, a return Amazon all-time low on Hyper’s 2026 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure for Mac, and some seriously deep clearance deals on Nomad’s leather and Sport iPhone 17 Pro/Max cases from $17. Scope it all out below.

Latest AirPods Pro 3 still sitting down at one of the best prices on Amazon…for now (Nearly 25% off)

Not only are the latest AirPods Max 2 still at $100 off in all five colors, but Amazon is somehow still offering a rock solid 24% off the latest AirPods Pro 3. After offering them down at $200 for Black Friday in July, Amazon actually dropped the price even lower and this deal is still live as of the time of writing.

Amazon is offering Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 down at $189.99 shipped right now.

Regularly $249, this is just south of 25% off the list price and one of the best deals we have tracked to date.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

These M5 MacBook Air configs are $270 off at official Apple refurb store today w/ full warranty

While we have caught a couple one-off configs in new condition in the $100 and $150 off range at Amazon, deals on M5 MacBook Air have been somewhere between short-lived at underwhelming at retail since the price hike. The official Apple refurb store is serving up some notable savings and day we are looking at a couple 13-inch and 15-inch configurations you can score at $270 off.

The offers we are highlighting here today include a 24GB/1TB 13-inch model and a 16GB/1TB model, both at the same price, and both at $270 under the list:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,529 (Reg. $1,799)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,529 (Reg. $1,799)
  • Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue

As far as pricing comparisons to new condition units go, that 15-inch model above is sitting at $1,699 ($100 off) via Amazon and only in two colors, while the 13-inch 24GB model is at $1,649($150 off) in Sky Blue and at least $50 more than that in the rest of the colors.

At this point, $150 off a new condition M5 MacBook Air is actually a notable discount, but the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is nearly delivering much deeper savings right now with a proper 1-year Apple warranty attached as well.

Amazon re-stocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Cell models at $100 off, deals from $299

While we are still tracking $100 price drops on the most affordable GPS-only base model Apple Watch Series 11 models, Amazon now refreshed its stock on the 46mm GPS + Cell configs and is now offering them at $100 off as well.

Amazon is now offering the GPS + Cellular 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 in carious case colors down at $429 shipped.

Regularly $529, this is a straight $100 price drop and on par with best deals we have been tracking over the month or so.

However, Amazon has had a hard time keeping the most affordable 46mm cell models in stock lately, and is now serving up the $100 price drop on the Jet Black, Silver, and Rose Gold case colors.

We did see these configs for $30 less during the Prime Day festivities, but this deal is matching the best since then.

The base model deals are still live as well:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

And we also still have the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations with the Black and the Anchor Blue Ocean Bands down at $699.99 shipped – that’s nearly $100 off.

First deal hits new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro lock with Ultra Wideband auto access

Among the first models out of the gate that ships Apple Home-compatible with Ultra Wideband tech that “just works,” we are now tracking the first solid price drop on the new Schlage Sense Pro UWB Smart Deadbolt Lock via Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the new Apple Home Key-ready Schlage Sense Pro UWB Smart Deadbolt Lock down at $338.74 shipped.

Regularly $400, this isn’t a giant discount or anything, but we are taking about the very chance to save on one of the latest lock solutions from one of the better brand in the space. As mentioned above, it is also among a select few that deliver Apple Home action alongside Ultra Wideband tech for auto locking and unlocking:

The Matter-ready smart lock (via a Thread-enabled home hub – Apple TV 4K, Home Pod (2nd Gen) or Home Pod Mini) leverages “Ultra Wideband and the user’s home key on a compatible iPhone or Apple Watch to deliver seamless hands-free unlock. The brand says it delivers intuitive hands-free entry “that understands intent to enter by calculating speed, trajectory, and motion and unlocks precisely as the user reaches their door.”

Hyper’s 2026 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure for Mac drops back to Amazon low at $80 off

If you’re in the market for a proper Thunderbolt 5 dock for your Mac setup, some of those budget models can really just end up being more of a headache than not in my experience. This highly-capable 2026 model HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD Enclosure, however, is very much up to the task and it has now dropped back down to its Amazon all-time low.

Amazon is now once again offering the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD Enclosure down at $319.99 shipped.

Massive clearance deals hit Nomad’s leather and Sport iPhone 17 Pro/Max cases from $17 (Up to 75% off)

With the series 18 iPhone lineup quickly approaching next month, Nomad is delivering some seriously deep clearance deals on its existing leather and Sport iPhone 17 Pro/Max cases at up to 75% off the list prices.

While not all models are still available for purchase, Nomad is more or less unloading its remaining stock on several of its wonderful leather iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max cases right now alongside some of its more affordable Sport models starting from just $17.

Not all colors and sizes are in-stock or marked down this low, but be sure to poke around on each of the three listing pages below for the 17 Pro and Pro Max sizes and additional color options:

  • Rugged Leather Case $21 (Reg. $85)
  • Modern Leather Case $30 (Reg. $69)
  • Sport Case $17 (Reg. $55)

Scoring Nomad’s sought-after cases at prices like this is nearly unheard of until we get into clearance territory, and if you’re not definitely picking up an 18 Pro or whatever else Apple has in-store next month, these are easily some of the better cases you can buy.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker’s 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display is down to just $56 today
  • Score four Matter plugs with automatic night lights for under $5 each today (All-time low)
  • UGREEN’s display-equipped 160W Nexode Pro can power five devices at once, now down to just $60
  • UGREEN’s 65W Nexode Air is one of the smallest chargers we’ve seen, now just $21.50 at nearly 50% off
  • David Pogue’s ‘Apple: The First 50 Years’ hardcover book now just $26 at Amazon (Orig. $50)

Apple Watch Ultra 3 Ocean Band configs now nearly $100 off at Amazon

Alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal at close to 25% off the list price, this morning Amazon is bringing back the nearly $100 price drops on the one-size-fits-just about anyone Apple Watch Ultra 3 Ocean Band configurations.

Amazon is now offering the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations with the matching Black Ocean Band and the Anchor Blue variant down at $699.99 shipped.

You’re looking at regularly $700 configurations at $99 off the list price for the lowest we can find. It appears as though stock on the black model is already running thin.

We did see the Natural model with the Blue Trail Loop down at $129 off a couple times over the last week or so, but today’s feature offers are on par with the lowest we have tracked over the Black Friday in July and early August offers on these Ocean Band configs.

Best Buy also had some deals on these models as part of its recent Apple Shopping Event, but they maxed out at $49 off, and are currently being offering at $750 as of today.

These deals also join a collection of the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models at $100 off with deals starting down at $299 for those not interested in the higher-end Ultra 3:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499)

All AirPods Max 2 colorways back at $100 off for this week’s 4-day Apple sale

While Amazon has now dropped the price on AirPods Pro 3 even lower as part of the end of week Apple sales running right now, the $100 discount on Apple’s latest AirPods Max 2 is alive and well.

Amazon is now offering all five colors of Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 over-ear headphones down at $449 shipped.

Regularly $549, this is $100 off the list price and the best price we can find.

This weekend’s deal is a carry over from the Black Friday and July sale. While select colors did recently jump back up in price for a short time, they are all now back at $100 off the list.

The only time we have seen Apple’s all-new, next-generation AirPods Max 2 sell for less than we are here today was during the late June Prime Day sale – you’re otherwise looking at the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon since release earlier this year.
